recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-12627 unless a future work-group decision changes the ElementDefinition.min datatype.
issue_request: FHIR-12627 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU2 FHIR-core change request to make ElementDefinition.min unsigned so that values are restricted to non-negative integers.
initial_application: Jira records svn revision 11313. The imported git commit ad4423fe33c2a169d16110361cbf83945b8435f8, `#12627 - change elementdefinition.min to unsignedInt`, changed the ElementDefinition.min source spreadsheet type from integer to unsignedInt.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini as a current datatype and normative artifact. FHIR-12918 later applied the same unsignedInt correction to ElementDefinition.base.min. FHIR-25544 later addressed a different cardinality constraint on new resource definitions and already has a reconcile commit on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml already has ElementDefinition.min typed as unsignedInt, and source/library/library-fhir-model-definition-content.xml exposes it as FHIR.unsignedInt.

related_jiras.note: Direct follow-up requiring ElementDefinition.base.min to mirror ElementDefinition.min's unsignedInt datatype; audited opportunistically in this run.
